init_cpa_api: initialize a CPA model API from an AnnData object with perturbation and covariate keys
train_cpa_model: train the CPA model for a specified number of epochs with early stopping and checkpointing
predict_perturbed_expression: predict gene expression for control cells under specified drug perturbations and doses
get_drug_embeddings: compute and return latent drug embedding vectors at a given dose as an AnnData object
latent_dose_response: generate a dose-response DataFrame showing latent response values across a range of doses
